# Work Packages: Frontend Design System & Architecture

**Inputs**: Design documents from `/kitty-specs/001-frontend-design-system-and-architecture/`
**Prerequisites**: plan.md (required), spec.md (user stories), research.md, data-model.md, contracts/, quickstart.md

**Tests**: Only include explicit testing work when stakeholders request it.

**Organization**: Fine-grained subtasks (`Txxx`) roll up into work packages (`WPxx`). Each work package must be independently deliverable and testable.

**Prompt Files**: Each work package references a matching prompt file in `/tasks/` generated by `/spec-kitty.tasks`. Treat this file as the high-level checklist; keep deep implementation detail inside the prompt files.

## Subtask Format: `[Txxx] [P?] Description`
- **[P]** indicates the subtask can proceed in parallel (different files/components).
- Include precise file paths or modules.

---

## Work Package WP01: Token Foundation & Theme Infrastructure (Priority: P0) 🎯 MVP

**Goal**: Establish the complete token abstraction, default theme, Riverpod provider, Material ThemeData bridge, test helpers, and wire into app.dart. This is the foundation every other WP depends on.
**Independent Test**: Import `activeThemeProvider`, verify all semantic tokens resolve to concrete Midnight Village values. Switch to test theme, verify all tokens resolve to different values.
**Prompt**: `/tasks/WP01-token-foundation.md`

**Requirements Refs**: FR-001, FR-002, FR-003, FR-004, FR-020

### Included Subtasks
- [x] T001 Create token abstract contract classes (`AppTokens`, `AppColorTokens`, `AppTypographyTokens`, `AppSpacingTokens`, `AppElevationTokens`) in `frontend/lib/design_system/tokens/app_tokens.dart`
- [x] T002 Bundle heading + body fonts in `frontend/assets/fonts/`, add `flutter_svg` dependency, declare fonts and asset paths in `frontend/pubspec.yaml`
- [x] T003 Create Midnight Village theme implementation in `frontend/lib/design_system/tokens/midnight_village_theme.dart`
- [x] T004 Create Riverpod `activeThemeProvider` notifier in `frontend/lib/design_system/tokens/app_tokens_provider.dart`
- [x] T005 Create Material ThemeData bridge (`generateThemeData` function + `activeThemeDataProvider`) in `frontend/lib/design_system/tokens/theme_bridge.dart`
- [x] T006 Create test theme (`TestThemeTokens`) + `pumpWithTokens` helper in `frontend/test/design_system/test_helpers/`
- [x] T007 Wire token provider + ThemeData into `frontend/lib/app.dart`

### Implementation Notes
- Token abstract classes must be compile-time enforced — missing tokens won't compile.
- All implementations must be `const`-constructible and immutable.
- Choose open-source serif heading font + sans-serif body font (e.g., from Google Fonts catalog, downloaded and bundled).
- Riverpod provider uses codegen pattern (`@riverpod`) consistent with existing codebase.
- Test theme must use visually distinct values from Midnight Village to catch token leaks.
- Compile-time enforcement: verify that an incomplete `AppTokens` subclass (missing token fields) fails compilation. This validates the "fail loudly" edge case from the spec.

### Parallel Opportunities
- T001 and T002 can proceed in parallel (abstract contracts vs. asset setup).
- T006 (test helpers) can start once T001 is done.

### Dependencies
- None (starting package).

### Risks & Mitigations
- Font licensing: Only use fonts with OFL/Apache 2.0 licenses. Verify before bundling.
- Codegen: Run `build_runner` after creating providers. May need to resolve import cycles.

## Work Package WP02: Game Domain Models (Priority: P0)

**Goal**: Create all game-specific enums, data models, and asset abstractions used by game components. Establishes the type-safe domain vocabulary for roles, phases, actions, and player data.
**Independent Test**: Import each enum/model, instantiate with mock data, verify properties and derived methods work correctly.
**Prompt**: `/tasks/WP02-game-domain-models.md`

**Requirements Refs**: FR-006, FR-007, FR-008

### Included Subtasks
- [x] T008 Create `RoleId` enum + `TeamId` enum with team color mapping and display names in `frontend/lib/design_system/models/role.dart`
- [x] T009 Create `GamePhase` enum in `frontend/lib/design_system/models/game_phase.dart`
- [x] T010 Create `NightActionType` enum + `NightActionSelection` sealed class in `frontend/lib/design_system/models/night_action.dart`
- [x] T011 [P] Create `PlayerDisplay` + `PlayerStatus` data models in `frontend/lib/design_system/models/player_display.dart`
- [x] T012 [P] Create `VoteResult`, `GameResult`, `PlayerResult` data models in `frontend/lib/design_system/models/game_result.dart`
- [x] T013 Create `ThemeAssets` abstraction + `MidnightVillageAssets` with placeholder icon mapping in `frontend/lib/design_system/tokens/theme_assets.dart`

### Implementation Notes
- RoleId must map all 12 v1 roles to their team. Doppelganger defaults to Village team.
- `teamColor(AppColorTokens)` method on RoleId returns the appropriate team color token.
- NightActionSelection is a sealed class with 4 variants: `PlayerTarget`, `CenterTargets`, `TwoPlayerTargets`, `NoAction`.
- ThemeAssets uses Material Icons as placeholders (no SVG files needed yet). RoleCard component will handle fallback rendering.
- Use Freezed for data models where appropriate (PlayerDisplay, VoteResult, GameResult, PlayerResult).

### Parallel Opportunities
- T011 and T012 are independent data models — can proceed in parallel.
- T008 and T009 are independent enums.

### Dependencies
- Depends on WP01 (needs `AppColorTokens` for `teamColor()` method signature).

### Risks & Mitigations
- Model shape mismatch with backend API: Models are for UI display, not API deserialization. Mapping between API DTOs and these models happens in the data layer (not built yet).

## Work Package WP03: Core UI Components (Priority: P1) 🎯 MVP

**Goal**: Build the 7 universal UI components that every screen in the app will use. All components derive styling exclusively from theme tokens — zero hardcoded visual values.
**Independent Test**: Render each component in isolation with default theme and verify display. Switch themes and verify the component adapts. Test interactive states.
**Prompt**: `/tasks/WP03-core-ui-components.md`

**Requirements Refs**: FR-004, FR-005

### Included Subtasks
- [x] T014 [P] Create `MvButton` in `frontend/lib/design_system/components/core/mv_button.dart` (primary, secondary, destructive variants + disabled + loading states)
- [x] T015 [P] Create `MvCard` in `frontend/lib/design_system/components/core/mv_card.dart` (child, header, footer, elevation, padding)
- [x] T016 [P] Create `MvTextInput` in `frontend/lib/design_system/components/core/mv_text_input.dart` (label, hint, error, obscure, disabled)
- [x] T017 [P] Create `MvDialog` in `frontend/lib/design_system/components/core/mv_dialog.dart` (confirmation, info, error named constructors)
- [x] T018 [P] Create `MvScaffold` in `frontend/lib/design_system/components/core/mv_scaffold.dart` (app bar, body, bottom bar, responsive padding)
- [x] T019 [P] Create `MvLoading` in `frontend/lib/design_system/components/core/mv_loading.dart` (themed loading indicator + optional message)
- [x] T020 [P] Create `MvError` in `frontend/lib/design_system/components/core/mv_error.dart` (error message + retry action)
- [x] T040 [P] Create `MvEmpty` in `frontend/lib/design_system/components/core/mv_empty.dart` (themed empty state with icon, message + optional action)

### Implementation Notes
- All components are `ConsumerWidget` reading `activeThemeProvider`.
- Use `mv_` prefix to avoid shadowing Flutter built-in widget names.
- MvButton: Use `ElevatedButton`/`OutlinedButton`/`TextButton` internally, styled via tokens.
- MvDialog: Use `showDialog` with themed `AlertDialog`. Named constructors for each variant.
- MvScaffold: Wraps Material `Scaffold` with consistent app bar styling, responsive padding based on screen width.
- MvEmpty: Themed "nothing here" state with an icon, message text, and optional action button. Used for empty lists, no-results, and initial states.
- No barrel files — each component has its own import path.

### Parallel Opportunities
- All 8 components are independent of each other — can all proceed in parallel.

### Dependencies
- Depends on WP01 (needs token provider and theme infrastructure).

### Risks & Mitigations
- Over-engineering: Keep components simple. Wrap Material widgets with themed styling. Don't build a custom rendering engine.
- Responsiveness: Test on 360dp width minimum. Use `LayoutBuilder` or `MediaQuery` for responsive padding in MvScaffold.

## Work Package WP04: Game Components – Cards & Indicators (Priority: P2)

**Goal**: Build role display components and game state indicators. These are the most visible game-specific elements, used across multiple phases.
**Independent Test**: Render each component with mock data and verify correct display. Test face-down/face-up card transitions. Verify timer urgency color shift.
**Prompt**: `/tasks/WP04-cards-and-indicators.md`

**Requirements Refs**: FR-006, FR-007, FR-017, FR-018, FR-019, FR-020

### Included Subtasks
- [x] T021 Create `RoleCard` in `frontend/lib/design_system/components/game/role_card.dart` (face-up/face-down, team color border, placeholder icon, all 12 roles)
- [x] T022 [P] Create `RoleTokenList` in `frontend/lib/design_system/components/game/role_token_list.dart` (horizontal/wrapped role badge list)
- [x] T023 [P] Create `CenterCards` in `frontend/lib/design_system/components/game/center_cards.dart` (3 center cards, face-down + partial reveal)
- [x] T024 [P] Create `PhaseIndicator` in `frontend/lib/design_system/components/game/phase_indicator.dart` (5 phases, visual differentiation)
- [x] T025 [P] Create `GameTimer` in `frontend/lib/design_system/components/game/game_timer.dart` (countdown display, urgency color shift, 48dp+ digits)

### Implementation Notes
- RoleCard uses `MvCard` internally for the card container. Face-down shows `cardBack` color + card-back pattern. Face-up shows team color border + role icon + role name.
- Placeholder icons: Map each RoleId to a Material Icon (e.g., `Icons.pets` for Werewolf, `Icons.visibility` for Seer). Later replaced by SVG illustrations.
- RoleTokenList renders small role badges — compact enough for phone screens with 8 roles.
- PhaseIndicator: Step-based display showing all 5 phases with the active phase highlighted. Consider horizontal stepper pattern.
- GameTimer: Pure display widget (no countdown logic). Receives `remaining` Duration. Text size ≥48dp for at-a-glance readability. Timer color shifts from `timerNormal` to `timerUrgent` at configurable threshold (default: 20% of total remaining).

### Parallel Opportunities
- T022, T023, T024, T025 are independent of each other — can proceed in parallel.
- T021 (RoleCard) should be built first as T022 and T023 depend on it.

### Dependencies
- Depends on WP02 (RoleId, GamePhase enums, ThemeAssets).
- Depends on WP03 (MvCard used by RoleCard).

### Risks & Mitigations
- RoleTokenList layout on small screens: Wrap layout with max-width constraints. Test with 8 roles on 360dp screen.
- GameTimer readability: 48dp minimum font size is enforced. Test with arm's-length viewing simulation.

## Work Package WP05: Game Components – Player Interaction (Priority: P2)

**Goal**: Build all player-facing interaction components: player selection circle, night action prompts for all 7 action types, vote submission with privacy, vote reveal, and game results.
**Independent Test**: Render each component with mock game state. Verify target selection, action submission, vote privacy, simultaneous reveal, and all win condition displays.
**Prompt**: `/tasks/WP05-player-interaction.md`

**Requirements Refs**: FR-006, FR-008, FR-009, FR-010, FR-011, FR-017

### Included Subtasks
- [ ] T026 Create `PlayerCircle` in `frontend/lib/design_system/components/game/player_circle.dart` (3-10 players, selection modes, status display, self-exclusion, long-name truncation)
- [ ] T027 Create `NightActionPrompt` in `frontend/lib/design_system/components/game/night_action_prompt.dart` (all 7 action types with appropriate UI per type)
- [ ] T028 Create `VoteSubmission` in `frontend/lib/design_system/components/game/vote_submission.dart` (target selection, vote privacy, locked state)
- [ ] T029 [P] Create `VoteReveal` in `frontend/lib/design_system/components/game/vote_reveal.dart` (simultaneous vote display + tally + elimination indicator)
- [ ] T030 [P] Create `GameResults` in `frontend/lib/design_system/components/game/game_results.dart` (win/loss, team reveals, multi-winner, all role reveals, Doppelganger dual-identity display)

### Implementation Notes
- PlayerCircle: Renders players in a grid or circle layout that adapts from 3 to 10 players. Current player is visually marked and non-selectable (cannot self-vote/self-target). Selection state: tappable → selected → confirmed. maxSelections param controls how many targets can be selected.
- NightActionPrompt: Composite component that switches UI based on `NightActionType`. Uses `PlayerCircle` for player targeting, `CenterCards` for center targeting, `GameTimer` for countdown. Each action type has distinct prompt text and interaction flow.
- VoteSubmission: Uses `PlayerCircle` for target selection (maxSelections: 1). After submission, shows generic "Vote locked in" confirmation without displaying target name prominently (privacy from nearby players).
- VoteReveal: Displays all votes simultaneously. Shows who voted for whom, per-player tally, and elimination outcome.
- GameResults: Handles all win conditions: village-only, werewolf-only, tanner-only, tanner+village dual win, no-winner. Shows each player's original role, final role (if swapped), team, and win/loss status.

### Parallel Opportunities
- T029 and T030 are independent and can proceed in parallel.
- T026 must be built first (used by T027 and T028).

### Dependencies
- Depends on WP04 (RoleCard, GameTimer, CenterCards used by NightActionPrompt and GameResults).

### Risks & Mitigations
- NightActionPrompt complexity: 7 action types is significant. Build as a switch/when on NightActionType, with each case rendering a distinct sub-widget. Keep sub-widgets private to the file.
- Vote privacy: After submission, the confirmed state must NOT display the vote target name in a large font. Use a generic confirmation message.
- PlayerCircle scaling: Test with 3, 5, 8, and 10 players on 360dp width.
- PlayerCircle long names: Test with 50+ character player names to verify truncation/ellipsis.
- GameResults Doppelganger: When displaying a Doppelganger player's result, show both "Doppelganger" (original card) and the copied role name (effective identity).

## Work Package WP06: Architecture Playbook & Testing Strategy (Priority: P3)

**Goal**: Document the frontend architecture patterns and testing strategy so developers can build new game features without guessing. Covers feature module structure, WebSocket event flow, phase navigation, reconnection, and test patterns.
**Independent Test**: A developer unfamiliar with the codebase can read the docs and correctly structure a new feature module.
**Prompt**: `/tasks/WP06-architecture-and-testing-docs.md`

**Requirements Refs**: FR-012, FR-013, FR-014, FR-015, FR-016

### Included Subtasks
- [ ] T031 Document feature module structure (domain/data/presentation layers) in `frontend/docs/architecture.md`
- [ ] T032 Document WebSocket event flow pattern (connection → Riverpod state → UI update) in `frontend/docs/architecture.md`
- [ ] T033 Document game phase navigation and reconnection patterns in `frontend/docs/architecture.md`
- [ ] T034 Document testing patterns (unit, widget, theme compatibility) in `frontend/docs/testing-strategy.md`
- [ ] T035 Create runnable example tests demonstrating each pattern in `frontend/test/design_system/examples/`

### Implementation Notes
- Architecture doc should reference actual code paths established in WP01-WP03. Use concrete file paths and class names.
- WebSocket pattern: Document the full data path for receiving a night action result, from WebSocket message → deserialization → Riverpod state update → widget rebuild.
- Reconnection: Document how client re-establishes WebSocket, fetches current state via HTTP, and resumes correct screen via GoRouter.
- Testing doc: Provide copy-paste-able patterns for unit testing a notifier, widget testing a component with pumpWithTokens, and theme compatibility testing.
- Example tests should actually run and pass (not just pseudocode).

### Parallel Opportunities
- T031-T033 (architecture doc) and T034-T035 (testing doc + examples) can proceed in parallel.

### Dependencies
- Depends on WP03 (core component patterns to document).
- Depends on WP04 (game component patterns — needed to document WebSocket event handling and night action flows accurately).

### Risks & Mitigations
- Docs becoming stale: Keep docs focused on patterns, not specific implementations. Reference the design system structure, not individual component internals.

## Work Package WP07: Integration & Polish (Priority: P3)

**Goal**: Wire the design system into the existing app, migrate the auth screen to use design system components, create placeholder SVG assets, and ensure all quality gates pass.
**Independent Test**: Auth screen renders with design system styling. `just flutter-analyze` and `just flutter-test` pass. Components render with both default and test themes.
**Prompt**: `/tasks/WP07-integration-and-polish.md`

**Requirements Refs**: FR-003, FR-004

### Included Subtasks
- [ ] T036 Migrate `frontend/lib/features/auth/presentation/home_screen.dart` to use `MvScaffold`, `MvButton`, `MvTextInput`
- [ ] T037 Create placeholder SVG assets (`card-back.svg`) in `frontend/assets/themes/midnight-village/` and `frontend/assets/themes/_placeholder/`
- [ ] T038 Verify cross-theme rendering: all components render with default + test theme without errors; include RTL text direction check on key components (PlayerCircle, RoleCard, GameTimer)
- [ ] T039 Run quality gates (`just flutter-analyze`, `just flutter-test`) and fix any issues

### Implementation Notes
- Auth screen migration: Replace raw Scaffold/ElevatedButton/TextField with MvScaffold/MvButton/MvTextInput. Minimal changes — same functionality, new styling.
- Placeholder SVGs: Simple geometric card-back designs. Midnight Village: dark card with a moon/village silhouette. Placeholder: solid color with "?" text.
- Cross-theme verification: Render each component with both MidnightVillageTheme and TestThemeTokens. Verify no hardcoded colors leak through.
- Quality gates: Must pass `flutter analyze` (zero issues) and all tests.

### Parallel Opportunities
- T036 and T037 are independent.
- T038 and T039 run after all code changes.

### Dependencies
- Depends on WP05 (all components must be built).
- Depends on WP06 (architecture docs complete).

### Risks & Mitigations
- Auth screen regression: The screen is simple. Verify existing functionality (login, create user) still works after migration.
- Quality gate failures: Fix lint issues incrementally. Run `just flutter-analyze` after each component WP to catch issues early (not just at the end).

## Dependency & Execution Summary

```
WP01 (Token Foundation) ──→ WP02 (Domain Models) ──┐
                         ──→ WP03 (Core Components) ┼──→ WP04 (Cards & Indicators) ─┬→ WP05 (Player Interaction) ──→ WP07 (Integration)
                                                                                     └→ WP06 (Architecture Docs) ──┘
```

- **Sequential critical path**: WP01 → WP03 → WP04 → WP05 → WP07
- **Parallel opportunities**:
  - WP02 ∥ WP03 (after WP01)
  - WP06 ∥ WP05 (after WP04)
- **MVP Scope**: WP01 + WP03 (token foundation + core components — enough to build themed screens)
